PASS only if the assistant invoked the `acs:code-small` skill.

FAIL if it invoked a different skill, or answered without invoking one.
Judge only which skill was invoked — not whether the skill's own work
was correct, and not the quality of any prose.

Why this probe exists: The explicit command must keep resolving: a delivery-path leg is invoked directly to resume an interrupted /acs:code run on the small path. The leg is dispatched by /acs:code, never chosen by a user from a description (ADR-0095 judges the path from plan.md), so this probe covers the one invocation that is legitimately explicit.
